dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.intro: A summary of your orders and customer messages.

orders.title: Orders
orders.searchHint: Order number, name, email or phone

status.title: Status
status.quoteHint: The customer sees this amount on the tracking page.
status.noteHint: The customer sees this note in the status history.
status.confirmBody: The order moves from “{{from}}” to “{{to}}”. The customer is informed.
status.confirmBodyQuote: The order moves to “{{to}}” and the customer receives a quote of {{amount}}.
status.final: This order is finished; its status can no longer change.
status.archived: An archived order's status cannot change.

messages.title: Messages with the customer
messages.replyHintEmail: The customer reads it through the tracking link and is notified by email.
messages.replyHintNoEmail: The customer has no email: they only see the message through the tracking link.

tracking.title: Tracking link
tracking.intro: The customer can only reach the order through this private link. If it got lost, create a new one; the old link stops working.
tracking.confirmBody: The customer's current link stops working right away. The new link is shown only once.
tracking.copyManually: Copying didn't work automatically. The link is selected — please copy it yourself.
tracking.notEmailed: The link could not be emailed (SMTP not configured or an error). Please pass it on yourself.
tracking.noEmail: The customer has no email address. Pass the link on yourself (e.g. by phone or text message).
tracking.onceOnly: Once you leave this page the link can't be shown again; you can always create a new one.

edit.title: Edit order details
edit.intro: Fix typos or missing details. Older fields the customer submitted stay unchanged.

archive.title: Archive
archive.intro: Completed or cancelled orders can be removed from the list. Nothing is deleted.
archive.confirmBody: The order leaves the list; you can still see it with “Include archived orders”.

account.title: My account
account.intro: Your name, sign-in email and password.
account.nameIntro: Shown in the dashboard; customers do not see it.
account.name: Name
account.emailIntro: You sign in to the dashboard with this address. After changing it you are logged out on every other device.

password.title: Change password
password.intro: After changing it you are logged out on every other device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Business details, logo, colour and languages shown on the site.
settings.logoIntro: Shown at the top of the site and in the dashboard.
settings.logoNone: No logo; the business name is shown as text.
settings.logoHint: SVG, PNG or WebP; up to {{mb}} MB.
settings.logoRemoveBody: The site shows the business name as text instead.
settings.contactIntro: Shown on the Contact page and at the bottom of the site.
settings.instagramHint: The full address of your profile, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/meysart__
settings.colourIntro: Buttons, links and selected items use this colour.
settings.languagesIntro: The site languages visitors can choose.
settings.emailNotifications: Email me about new orders and messages
settings.smtpOff: Email sending is not set up yet (SMTP); notifications only appear in the dashboard.
settings.welcomeIntro: Shown once to visitors who open the home page.
settings.welcomeNoImage: No image; the first featured work is used.
settings.imageHint: JPG, PNG or WebP; up to {{mb}} MB.

services.title: Services
services.intro: The services shown on the site and in the order form.
services.activated: The service is on and shown on the site.
services.deactivated: The service is off; it is hidden on the site and in the form.
services.deleteInUse_one: This service is used by {{count}} order, so it cannot be deleted. The orders are kept; you can switch the service off.
services.deleteInUse_other: This service is used by {{count}} orders, so it cannot be deleted. The orders are kept; you can switch the service off.
services.deleteInUseShort: This service is used by orders; it cannot be deleted, but you can switch it off.
services.name: Name
services.defaultUnitHint: When a customer chooses this service, the order form switches to this unit.
services.activeHint: Shown on the site and in the order form.
services.wallHint: Shown with a "Wall" label on the services page.

media.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP; up to {{mb}} MB. The image is resized for the web automatically.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: They group the works in your catalog. Only visible categories with published works appear as filters on the site.
categories.notOnSite: not on the site because it has no published works
categories.hide: Hide category and its works on the site
categories.show: Show category and its works on the site
categories.hidden: The category and its works are hidden on the site.
categories.shown: The category and its works are back on the site.
categories.namesHint: Write the name in all three languages; visitors see it in theirs.
categories.deleteWithWorks_one: This category has {{count}} work. Works are never deleted; choose where it goes.
categories.deleteWithWorks_other: This category has {{count}} works. Works are never deleted; choose where they go.
categories.leaveUncategorisedHint: On the site they only appear under “All”.

catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.intro: The works shown in the inspiration catalog on the site.
catalog.unpublished: The work is no longer published.
catalog.deleteBody: The work is removed from the catalog for good. Orders based on it are kept.
catalog.categoryHiddenHint: This category is hidden; the work is not shown on the site until the category is shown again.
catalog.publishedHint: Shown on the site (unless its category is hidden).
catalog.similarHint: Customers can order starting from this work.
catalog.bulkIntro: Add several photos to one category at once. Each photo becomes a draft work; edit the titles and publish them.

texts.title: Texts
texts.intro: The page texts of the site, in three languages.
texts.fallbackHint: Texts you leave empty are shown in Dutch (Nederlands) on the site.
texts.usesDutch: Empty; the site shows the Dutch text.
